artworks.title: Hog Slaughterers
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Gerard ter Borch the Younger (formerly Jan Pietersz Saenredam)
artworks.medium: etching, roulette, and mezzotint with burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16 × 16 cm (6 5/16 × 6 5/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an inner courtyard with two figures engaged in a task. The scene shows buildings with multiple windows casting shadows over the space. The lines are sharp, emphasizing the play of sunlight and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Church Interior
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Pieter Jansz Saenredam
artworks.medium: roulette and etching with burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper and hand-colored with wash
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 19.2 × 15.1 cm (7 9/16 × 5 15/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a painting of the interior of a grand cathedral or church. The image shows a spacious interior with tall columns and a checkerboard-patterned floor. The architecture is elaborate, featuring arched windows with stained glass filtering light into the space. Decorative crests and ornamental elements adorn the walls and columns. The interior space is open and tranquil, suggesting a place of worship.

artworks.title: Winding River
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Herman Saftleven
artworks.medium: chalk manner with etched hatching printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.2 × 6.4 cm (3 5/8 × 2 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterway with floating and stacked logs. Along the left side are trees with detailed foliage. In the center is the mast of a boat, and in the distance is a windmill with arms stretched out above the horizon line. The horizon is high in the composition, offering a wide landscape view. The color palette consists of light brown and sepia tones, possibly drawn with chalk or crayon.

artworks.title: Shipyard
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Herman Saftleven
artworks.medium: chalk manner with etched hatching printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.3 × 6.4 cm (3 11/16 × 2 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with tall trees blocking the horizon on the right side. The focus is on the near environment rather than the distant sky. The artwork uses soft strokes, giving a textured effect. The color palette consists of varying shades of sepia and black. The composition includes large logs, an overturned boat, a small wooden building, and a stone house. In the background, two figures are partially visible near the trees.

artworks.title: The Collector
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Bernhard Schreuder (printmaker), after Jan Steen
artworks.medium: chalk manner, etching, aquatint and roulette with burnishing printed in black ink
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15.7 × 13.2 cm (6 3/16 × 5 3/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with two figures engaged in a discussion. The drawing depicts a detailed interior setting with one figure seated at a table holding a document or a piece of paper, while the other stands leaning slightly forward across the table. The surroundings consist of a cluttered workspace with various objects like books and papers on a shelf, and items such as hats hanging from the wall. The table is covered with papers, an inkwell, and a quill. The drawing utilizes delicate hatching and cross-hatching to define forms and create depth, with a strong emphasis on the textures of clothing and backgrounds. The monochrome use of ink and wash gives the piece an historical and contemplative feel.

artworks.title: Cavalier and Lady with a Page
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Gerard ter Borch the Younger
artworks.medium: aquatint with etching printed in red-brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 34.8 × 25 cm (13 11/16 × 9 13/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: Three individuals are in the image. On the left, a young boy stands holding a tray. In the center, a man wears a wide-brimmed hat and cloak. To the right, a woman sits in a chair drinking from a glass. The setting suggests a room with simple furnishings.

artworks.title: Shepherd and Shepherdess with Their Flock
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Adriaen van de Velde
artworks.medium: chalk manner and etched hatching printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 25.8 × 24.8 cm (10 3/16 × 9 3/4 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with animals and people near a body of water. The horizon is suggested by distant hills and trees. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes accentuating textures like tree foliage and water reflections. The color palette is sepia, emphasizing the tranquil scene. A woman and man, along with cows and sheep, are under a large tree. In the background, more sheep are visible, along with faint outlines of structures.

artworks.title: Gateway with Traveler and Mule
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Thomas Wyck
artworks.medium: chalk manner and aquatint  with an etched border printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 14.9 × 23 cm (5 7/8 × 9 1/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows an old, weathered building with arched openings to the left, viewed from a low angle perspective. The horizon is positioned towards the upper part of the image. The buildings recede into the distance. The architectural structure in the foreground is highlighted with varied shades of brown, defining its texture and aged appearance. The monochrome palette creates a historic feel. Brushstrokes suggest a detailed rendering, capturing the stonework's texture and rough surfaces. A small group of donkeys stand to the left of center, adding to the rustic atmosphere. The sky has some cloud formations, contrasting with the detailed architecture below.

artworks.title: Ceiling Decoration
artworks.artist: Bernhard Schreuder after Jacob de Wit
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image showcases sweeping curves and billowing lines resembling cloud formations. Human forms are intertwined with the clouds, evoking a sense of movement. The figures are scattered across the composition like cherubs.

artworks.title: Rembrandt, Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Richard Earlom after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Ruth Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with the upper half of their body visible, positioned slightly turned to the right and looking directly at the viewer. The person has a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and a slightly pursed mouth. They have curly white hair extending from a dark hat. The person wears a dark coat lined with fur, revealing fur near their shoulder and arm, over a high-collared shirt. Their arms are crossed in front of them. The background is a uniform dark tone that contrasts with their lighter complexion, highlighting the details of their face and clothing. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person.

artworks.title: Near Rouen (Environs de Rouen)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Ruth Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a large sailing ship dominating the foreground, located slightly left of center. In the background, there is a horizon where the calm water meets a line of blurred trees and windmills in the distance. The sky above is filled with textured clouds rendered in fine pencil-like strokes, creating an atmospheric effect. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray. Closest to us, there is a small group of people gathered on a stone bank on the left, with others seen aboard the ship and in smaller boats nearby.

artworks.title: A Bather
artworks.description: The image shows a female figure standing near a body of water. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, where the water meets dense vegetation. The technique involves soft brushstrokes that create a smudged effect. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white, creating a contrast between light and shadow. Dense foliage frames the scene, and lighter areas lead the eye towards the water. The background features blurred vegetation, adding depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: The Country Dance (Small Plate) (La danse sous les arbres)
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a group of figures in a clearing surrounded by tall trees. Some figures are dancing while others are seated. Animals graze in the background, and mountains are faintly visible in the distant horizon. The artwork is created using fine, detailed brushstrokes to show textures and contrasts of light and shadow. The color scheme is monochrome, emphasizing dark and light shades for depth and detail.

artworks.title: Saint Francis of Assisi
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated against a cross, holding it to his chest. He has long hair, a beard, and a contemplative expression. He wears a robe and rests his bare feet on the ground, with a skull in his lap. The background includes trees and a fallen log, with a glowing effect around the man's head.

artworks.title: Deliberation (Beratung)
artworks.description: The image shows angular lines and sharp geometric shapes, forming three humanoid figures. The figures seem to be conversing, with exaggerated limbs and facial outlines creating a sense of movement. The woodcut print technique adds texture and depth to the stark black and white contrast of the composition.

artworks.title: Allegory of Fortune
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a winged figure holding a cherub next to a horse and a person in armor. The artwork portrays a detailed scene with mythological and allegorical elements. The winged figure embraces the cherub, who reaches towards them, as they stand beside a horse. The person in armor interacts with the horse. The background shows a stacked block wall. The intricate details, such as feathers, clothing folds, and horse anatomy, are depicted with fine lines and shading. The text at the bottom reads: "Io son fortuna buona, ho mecco Amore, Se mi conosci, ti farò signore." The artwork's composition and style suggest influences from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Joseph Reveals Himself to His Brothers
artworks.description: This drawing depicts classical architecture and figures in an elaborate scene. The image shows a group of figures gathered around a central character in a grand setting with tall fluted columns, classical sculptures, objects, and animals. Relief sculptures, arches, and decorative elements enhance the atmosphere. The image is dense with figures and ornate details.

artworks.title: Semiramis on the Lion Hunt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession or caravan-like scene set in a lush landscape. The image depicts an assembly of camels and horses surrounded by vegetation, with several people leading and accompanying the animals. There are intricate details in the foliage of the trees and in the rocky terrain. At the foreground rests a pair of lions. The background features distant mountains beneath a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 1 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a procession in front of a grand architectural setting. There is a central structure, potentially a ceremonial gate, with intricate designs such as arches and columns. There are mounted figures in elaborate costumes and soldiers marching in formation. The scene is detailed with fine linework, capturing textures and patterns clearly. It is monochromatic, enhancing the contrast between elements and highlighting architectural and figure details.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 2 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men on horseback in a formation. They are in profile view, with a leader on the left and followers to the right. The leader is calmly seated on his horse, wearing a cloak and a wide-brimmed hat. He has distinct facial features with a mustache and a serious expression. The followers are similarly dressed with hats, cloaks, and boots. Some horses are rearing up, while others are marching beside their riders. One follower is holding a long rod. In the background, distant structures like windmills can be seen under a blank sky. The foreground is a flat landscape with small vegetation.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 3 of 6]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of horse riders in elaborate attire. The riders are mounted on horses and are dressed in detailed embellishments. The horses are depicted with precision, appearing to be trotting or standing elegantly. The background is minimal, allowing the focus to remain on the intricate portrayal of the horses and riders. Lines and shading emphasize the movement and posture of both riders and horses.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 4 of 6]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mounted riders in elaborate attire. The artwork features detailed depictions of horses and riders, with line work and shading. The riders are dressed in period clothing with ornate hats and garments. The horses are shown in various stances, conveying movement. The background is minimalistic with cloud formations and a vast sky. Detailed line work is used to highlight designs on the attire and the musculature of the horses.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 5 of 6]
artworks.description: The image shows a group of horses standing together. The horses are detailed with elaborate saddles and bridles, and the backdrop is a sky defined by delicate lines and minimalistic clouds. The detailed line work emphasizes texture and form, particularly in depicting the manes of the horses and the fabric of the clothing.

artworks.title: Entry of Marie de Medici into Amsterdam [plate 6 of 6]
artworks.description: This is an etching drawing of a scene with a horse-drawn carriage, mounted riders, and a group of people and a dog. The image portrays a group traveling scene, with a carriage on the left that holds a woman under a canopy. Several individuals are mounted on horses, while others stand or walk beside them. To the right, more people gather, seemingly positioned in a group discussion or meeting. In the foreground, a dog appears to be leading or inspecting the way. The use of line work and cross-hatching suggests detailed texture in the clothing and the animals, providing a sense of depth and movement to the scene.
